BiblicalUsage: Jealous is the name God gives Himself: I the LORD thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, the LORD, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God. The LORD thy God is a consuming fire, even a jealous God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God's jealousy is the jealousy of a husband for His bride, not the envy of a rival, and it is the reason idolatry is adultery and not a mistake. My position is that a God who is not jealous would not love us at all.
